newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek 96 C/A deficit around 3.5pct of GDP- min.
newsitem.headline: Greek 96 C/A deficit around 3.5pct of GDP- min.

text.p: Greece's current account deficit widened to about $4.6 billion in 1996 from $3.023 billion the previous year, but was still in line with Greece's EU convergence programme at 3.5 percent of GDP, National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou told reporters.
Faster economic growth that led to higher spending on imports was largely responsible for the larger deficit in 1996, said Papandoniou.

Bank of Greece figures put the current account deficit at $4.75 billion in the first 11 months of 1996 compared to $3.023 in the same period of 1995. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
